title: Starfall, a browser game built from scratch
brief: Please build a small browser game from scratch, in a folder called starfall inside the Projects folder in your home folder. In the game you steer a little ship along the bottom of the screen, dodge falling stars and catch energy orbs, and the stars fall faster as the score climbs. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only, all in that one folder, with no libraries and no internet. Do all the work in your own terminal, through the shell's agent_run action: that is how you make the folder, write each file and look at what you wrote. Do not use the Terminal app. Start by writing a short plan into a file called PLAN.md in that folder: a checklist of about eight steps, from an empty page to a finished game with a start screen, score, levels, keyboard and touch controls, and sound that stays off until the player turns it on. Then work through the plan one step at a time: write or change the files, open the game's index.html in the browser to see what you made, fix what you see, and tick the step off in PLAN.md. People are watching the screen, so keep each step small and visible. When every step is ticked and the game plays well, say FINISHED on its own line.
keep_going: Please keep going on Starfall. Read PLAN.md in the starfall folder through the shell's agent_run action. If the folder or the plan does not exist yet, make them first, as the brief said. Otherwise take the first step that is not ticked, do it, look at the game in the browser, then tick that step off in PLAN.md. If every step is ticked and the game plays well from the start screen to game over, say FINISHED on its own line.
